title: Eric Davis calls Townsend Brown a phony

tellings.quote: um Eric Davis got in touch with me and was like Towns and Brown is a a phony.

plain: Eric Davis, a physicist who has worked on government studies of UFOs, is said to have contacted Michels and told him that Thomas Townsend Brown, an inventor whose experiments are often cited as early antigravity work, was "a phony". Michels recounts this himself on an episode with the UFO activist Steven Greer. It matters because it would knock down a figure many people see as a pioneer.
